memory.content: Engineering findings come to the technical lead, not security; security owns security only; security escalates to the owner only for product, architecture, cost, production risk, or protected actions; no production changes unless the owner says go.
Do not create additional specialist bots without the owner's approval.
The owner cares a lot about quality-testing AI features (marking comments, tutor, grade fairness), not only whether mark/tutor endpoints return 200.
